mu_batch_h.description: specific growth rate in the batch phase (until glucose depletion; for cell counts, samples below 80 % of peak VCD)

glucose_depletion_h.description: first sample with glucose < 0.1 g/L (resolution = sampling interval)

acetate_peak_gL.description: highest acetate up to 0.5 h after glucose depletion (overflow)

acetate_reconsumed_frac.description: fraction of peak acetate consumed 0.75–2.5 h after glucose depletion

Yxs_batch_gg.description: biomass yield on glucose in the batch phase (only if glucose falls monotonically)

extract_consumed_frac.description: fraction of the initial real extract consumed by the last sample

ivcd_1e9_cells_h_L.description: integral of viable cell density over the run (trapezoid)

titer_final_gL.description: product titer at the last sample

qp_pg_cell_day.description: cell-specific productivity: product made ÷ integral of viable cells

activity_final_AU_mL.description: product activity at the last sample (assay-specific; compare within a product)

viability_80_h.description: first sample after peak VCD with viability below 80 % (culture decline)

diameter_end_um.description: mean viable cell diameter at the last sample

mu_fedbatch_h.description: mean growth rate after glucose depletion (fed-batch); depends on the feed
